integrity: Mathematical proof supplied; finite checks are corroborative only. Prior complete-tower singleton densities and finite-level density products are attributed to the original sources.
scientific_limitations: The asymptotic fixes a finite nonempty forbidden-prime set and lets mosaic depth tend to infinity; no uniformity in growing forbidden sets or elementary closed form for the limiting Euler product is asserted. Earlier work establishes related densities and height bounds. Independent priority and proof validation are outstanding.
title: Prime-power towers govern the stabilization of mosaic-avoidance densities
